answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. Reaching the tide of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sonnet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the walnut of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
